source: Original AI editorial shortlist authored for CLEAN Words; not extracted from an existing puzzle answer sequence.
difficulty: provisional; no frequency or player calibration data
spellingPolicy: Uppercase ASCII five-letter ordinary English vocabulary; primarily US spelling, with some familiar UK alternatives. Only entries accepted by frozen enable-five-v1 are eligible.
inflectionPolicy: Avoid regular plural/third-person -s and routine -ed variants selected solely to fill the bank. Familiar irregular forms, independent common lexical forms, participial adjectives, comparatives and ordinal numbers are allowed. No suffix-only heuristic establishes eligibility.
properNamePolicy: Exclude proper-name-only words, brand names and demonyms. A word that is also a name may be eligible for an ordinary lowercase sense (e.g. ROBIN bird, AMBER resin, MAYOR office).
sensitiveContentPolicy: Exclude explicit sexual vocabulary, slurs, targeted insults and graphic violence. Neutral references to illness, grief, law and ordinary conflict may remain. Editorial screening is AI-only and cannot guarantee cultural suitability.
selectionPolicy: AI-curated everyday objects, actions, descriptions, natural features and common abstract ideas; dictionary membership confirms guess compatibility only, never familiarity.
ownershipNotice: Original selection and metadata prepared for CLEAN Words. Individual English words are factual vocabulary. No third-party answer corpus was copied. Existing ENABLE validation list remains subject to its bundled public-domain notice and app attribution.
